Movement, Wellness & Community!

About this Event

Join us for a special fall outdoor yoga class - celebrating community + movement!
Class Details:
Check-in: 1:45pm
Class: 2:00-3:00pm
What to bring: yoga mat, towel, water bottle
Class will be OUTDOORS, please plan to dress appropriately (layers/bug spray)
Dress Code: Fall color activewear
Location: Class will be held in the grassy courtyard space by the courtyard/fountain. NO NEED TO CHECK IN AT THE STUDIO. Meet down by the fountain 15 mins prior to class start time.
Parking: Enter off Oakland Ave. to Parkview Place, park in the Hampton Inn parking. Parking Map here: https://ibb.co/QFQ4p1mP
Questions: Email QmV0aGFueSAhIExhbmcgfCB5b2dhc2l4ICEgY29t
Hosted by YogaSix St. Louis & Carli Bell
